text:
tara.sales: Meridian wants a short POC (2 weeks) to test switching from HelixAPI to Redwood. Key asks: prompt parity incl. function-calls, session affinity/handshake, KMS key rotation/BYK for keys, and a token-billing delta. Who can own tech + security?

ben.se: I can lead presales. Do they use streaming + tool-calls? Those are common parity pain points.

tara.sales: Yes: streaming, function-calls, and per-call session tokens for affinity.

kevin.eng: I'll run parity tests. Plan: get their golden prompts (1k ideal), run through our eval harness, and add a tokenizer shim plus a serialize-tools compatibility toggle to match Helix behavior. Need sample Helix outputs if they do any post-processing.

sasha.security: BYK note: Hosted plan doesn't allow importing customer keys into our HSM today. Dedicated/Private can do BYK with KMS rotation. For the POC we can provision a small Dedicated pool with BYK but need legal addendum and ops lead time.

maria.legal: I'll draft the BYK addendum and update the NDA. Meridian also asked for EU data residency, so confirm eu-west pool.

kevin.eng: We can spin a eu-west dedicated pool. Early run caveat: token-count deltas typically +5-12% due to tokenizer differences; streaming framing and function-call framing can push variance up to ~20% on edge cases. The serialize-tools toggle should handle argument ordering differences.

tara.sales: Deliverables for 2-week POC: smoke parity tests, token delta report with example diffs, BYK path + lead time, and a billing delta estimate.

ben.se: Action items: 1) Eng: parity harness + token deltas; 2) Security/Ops: BYK checklist and ETA; 3) Legal: addendum; 4) Sales: collect acceptance criteria and volume metrics for billing projection.

ops-bot: Infra request queued: 1x eu-west dedicated tenant (2x A100) with BYK enabled. ETA ~3h for minimal provisioning.

kevin.eng: I'll run an initial smoke pass today and post a short diff report (10 examples + token counts). Early findings: Helix trims trailing newlines and canonicalizes emojis which changes tokens; shimming those reduces delta. Also their function-call ordering is insertion-order; our runtime may reorder args unless serialize toggle enabled.

sasha.security: I'll confirm whether we can import keys to HSM for POC or need a temporary hosted KMS bridge and list audit log requirements.

maria.legal: BYK addendum draft will be circulated by EOD.

tara.sales: Thanks all. I'll schedule kickoff and include acceptance criteria: >=90% parity on their golden set, token-delta estimate, and confirmed BYK path. :thumbsup:
